chains.trait: Enormous scavenging beaks & vicious thumb claws
links: Crack calcified bone and rip carrion hides -> seasonal drought cycles create episodic die-offs across alkaline prairies -> 18° axial tilt driving predictable resource pulses and seasonal droughts

skill.effect: The creature cracks open sturdy hides with its beak and claws to reach the marrow, leaving nearby foes weak and easily harmed for a short while.

chains.weakness: Beak becomes brittle and prone to fracture if diet lacks sufficient calcium cycling.
observe: Three-meter hairy frame casting long shadows
Massive, tooth-derived beak snapping shut with hydraulic force
Thumb claws digging into putrefying remains

journal.en: They turn death into a feast, and a feast into a cage.

plausibility.summary: Note calcium demands on enamel-derived beak and tie brittleness weakness to drought-limited F12 mineral cycling, not vague diet alone.

relations.note: Both exploit alkaline prairie loams; Insectophagi harvest insect colonies while Bone Crushers monopolize vertebrate carrion, creating territorial friction over nutrient sources.
Predator pinnae detect Bone Crusher carrion-scent gland sprays, allowing them to intercept scavengers or avoid contaminated kills.
